summary: Alvotech filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, the non-US equivalent of a US 8-K) furnishing an October 20, 2026 press release announcing FDA approval of a new manufacturing process, Process 2.0, for SIMLANDI (adalimumab-ryvk), its Humira biosimilar, at its DSM2 suite in Reykjavik, Iceland. The change more than doubles drug-substance output per batch without altering upstream scale, with demonstrated comparability. No transaction, price, stake, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed; this is an ordinary regulatory/operational update, not a special situation. Watch commercialization and capacity implications rather than any deal arbitrage.
